note: City of Tomahawk park on Lake Mohawksin (Wisconsin River flowage). Sites 1-10 are angled back-ins off W Somo Avenue facing the water across a mowed strip and a line of shoreline shrubs; public beach, boat landing and playground in the park. No generators. The city also sells sites 11-30 at Vision Pointe Campground, past the dog park at 1025 W Somo Ave. --Claude
summary: City page + the city's RoverPass listing read: 10 sites (1-10) with 30/50-amp electric and non-potable water, $50/night ($300/week), 4-6 people a site, 14-night max, showers, dump only off site (City Garage, $10), no generators; open April 27 - October 13; booked on RoverPass. WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview (continuous shoreline shrub line). Phone 715-453-3654 not found -> 715-453-4040. Vision Pointe sites 11-30 noted.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview: on Esri z19 the ten angled sand pads (sites 1-10, ~45.4750,-89.7402 along W Somo Ave) end about 20 m from an unbroken band of shoreline shrubs and small trees, with the water a further ~10-15 m beyond (pads to water ~30-35 m). The band runs the whole frontage with only small gaps, and the city's own campground map draws a continuous tree line between the sites and the lake. Open mowed grass between pads and the shrub line, so the lake is in view; a thin line of trees = a view, not on-water. All ten sites are sold by the night ($50). Stored evidence ('no road or treeline between the pads and the water') is contradicted at z19.

VISION POINTE: the city's RoverPass listing now also sells sites 11-30 at 'Vision Pointe Campground at SARA Park' ('past the Dog Park at 1025 W Somo Ave'), same 30/50-amp electric + non-potable water and $50 rate. It sits on the peninsula west of the railroad, about 45.4741,-89.7466 (~500 m west of sites 1-10, its own loop road off W Somo Ave per the city's map) - under ~1 km, so not a split; the reviewer may prefer to fold its 20 sites into this entry (count 30). Esri imagery predates it (the area shows the fenced dog park and open field only), so its waterfront cannot be judged from imagery; the city's map draws sites 17-27 along the north shore behind a tree line and 11-16 near the southwest water.
PHONE: stored 715-453-3654 appears on neither the city page nor the RoverPass listing; both give City Hall (715) 453-4040 -> replace 715-453-3654 -> 715-453-4040.

REVIEWS: the RoverPass listing shows 3.9 from 48 reviews (covers the city's campground and park facilities listing). Local campground, so no price gate; the city posts a nightly rate and books every site by the night - not a seasonal park.
